title: lane r5 operator-relayed: fix-scale review dispatch mechanics unstated — inline review by the orchestrating session
description: Lane round 5, operator-relayed finding from mdatron's live #52 execution (2026-07-20). Defect: the lane amendment specifies the fix's gates, composition, and supplement but not its REVIEW DISPATCH mechanics — nothing states that fix-scale domain reviews run as cold dispatches with manifests under Recorded review dispatch, so the mdatron session ran them inline in the orchestrating session, filed them to hand-coined review-log slugs (the free-filename incident class), and carried lifecycle state dual-home — three named falsifications executed by a cooperating session consciously following the lane rule, caught by the operator, not mechanically. Evidence: mdatron #52 comment trail; remediated by folding into typed comments and deleting the files. Proposed: resolved-candidate — the fix inherits Recorded review dispatch explicitly (fix-scale reviews are cold-dispatched with manifests; inline review by the implementing session is a named violation), and the incident seeds the corpus: an inline-review/free-slug/dual-home fixture for the lifecycle and dispatch falsifiers. This is a NEW deviation class (dispatch layer), distinct from the ungated-fix class — it does not advance the lane apparatus's second-case counter but is the first case for the dispatch-mechanics clause it motivates.
